changelog:
Initial release of Xiaohongshu Post Analyzer – a tool for in-depth analysis and optimization of Xiaohongshu post content.

- Analyzes emotional tone and persuasive elements in posts
- Evaluates readability and audience attraction
- Predicts engagement: likes, saves, comments, and shares
- Identifies key strengths and weaknesses
- Provides actionable suggestions to improve interaction and virality
- Outputs a Viral Potential Score (1–10) with an explanation
